imp.intent: Scaffold Open UX in github.com/3dyonic/open-ux: one catalog, Hybrid C tools, hosted register→uxmcp_ bearer, self-host stdio no auth, privacy constraints, Fly/Railway config, thin Claude plugin, MIT.
imp.subtitle: cited UX rules agents audit against / shared cited guidelines
imp.layout: packages/mcp (Python FastMCP); catalog/ (JSON+schema stub); clients/claude (thin plugin); packs/; docs/
imp.tools: list_guidelines; get_guideline; audit(target.type html|jsx|description). Hybrid C, no server LLM. reasons[] = catalog pass_when/fail_when + guideline_id.
imp.catalog: Schema-valid empty guidelines.json. jobs[]/patterns[] empty. Soft 100KB / hard 256KB. UNS-44 ×3 not invented here.
imp.auth: Hosted: POST /register email → uxmcp_ bearer; 401 on /mcp without key; soft 60/min 1k/day. Stdio: no auth.
imp.privacy: Never persist audit.content. Keys hashed at rest. Logs by key_hash. Email issue/revoke only. Telemetry: callers, tool mix, verdicts, rule ids, target type. Retention 30d. Account delete wipes keys+logs. Self-host telemetry off.
imp.deploy: Dockerfile + fly.toml + railway.toml. README how-to. No live URL in this PR.
imp.claude: displayName Open UX; skill pointer connect→key→list→one audit; no duplicated rule bodies; Thursday = URL+key in client settings.
imp.tests: empty catalog; unauthorized 401; raw content not stored.
imp.held: PR open. Do not merge. Hold for Architect review.
